assumptions: One recurring ordinary payment source per observed person income key; monthly amount is annual observation / 12, using the fixture stable_monthly_income declaration.
Employment means ordinary wages, pension means ordinary pension, military retired pay and SBP are separate unearned sources. No source is classified as legally countable by the bridge.
This bounded slice excludes net self-employment, regular interest/dividends and household TANF; any nonzero unmapped source is rejected.
